visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches into a lush tomato plant in an outdoor garden under bright, direct sunlight, inspecting clusters of green and red cherry tomatoes. (2) The hand holds up a single red tomato to the camera, revealing a small circular hole where a bird or insect has pecked into it. (3) A pink plastic colander filled with multicolored cherry tomatoes is placed under a kitchen faucet with a strong stream of running water in a stainless steel sink. (4) Red tomatoes and several peeled white garlic cloves are tossed into a clear glass blender jar placed on a kitchen counter. (5) The blender is activated, spinning the ingredients until they become a smooth, vibrant red liquid sauce. (6) The thick tomato sauce is poured from the blender over pieces of fish in a white ceramic dish sitting on a black stovetop. (7) White, translucent konjac noodles and brown meatballs are added to the red sauce, which has begun to bubble and simmer in the pan. (8) A hand sprinkles freshly chopped green scallions over the top of the boiling stew, adding color to the dish. (9) A piece of the cooked fish is placed into a small, clear storage container while the main dish continues to steam in the background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近花園好多番茄. (2) [Subtitle]: 都被小動物偷吃了😆. (3) [Subtitle]: 留一些給大自然吧. (4) [Subtitle]: 加點蒜頭打碎. (5) [Subtitle]: 番茄富含谷氨酸（天然味精）什麼調味料都不用放. (6) [Subtitle]: 加點蒟蒻麵. (7) [Subtitle]: 牛肉丸. (8) [Subtitle]: 起鍋前加點蔥花. (9) [Subtitle]: 因為沒有調味料 寶寶也可以吃唷.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Only the hands of a person with light skin tone are visible throughout the video.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in an outdoor garden area with tomato plants and soil, then transitions to an indoor kitchen with a stainless steel sink, a modern blender, and a gas stovetop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat Japanese pop song featuring a female vocalist, bright acoustic guitar strumming, and a steady electronic drum beat. Faint chirping from birds can be heard in the background. (2) A sharp transition occurs to the sound of high-pressure water rushing and splashing against vegetables and plastic, drowning out some of the BGM's lower frequencies. (3) A distinct mechanical click is heard, followed by a loud, high-pitched motorized whirr from a blender, which fluctuates in pitch as the ingredients are liquefied. (4) The audio shifts to a rhythmic, low-frequency bubbling and boiling sound as the stew simmers on the stove. Soft rustling of plastic bags and liquid pouring are interspersed with the constant BGM. (5) The bubbling sound continues, layered with the melodic chorus of the song, before fading out as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video demonstrates a natural way to cook fish and noodle stew using garden-fresh cherry tomatoes as the base sauce. The creator highlights that the dish requires no additional seasonings because tomatoes are naturally rich in flavor, making it a healthy option suitable for babies.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-paced editing and vibrant colors to create a pleasant and health-conscious vibe for a home-cooking tutorial.
